page_title: FRO 0-1 UDI | Frosinone v Udinese 26/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Fabio Cannavaro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christian Kabasele (Udinese) replacing Keinan Davis.
90+5' The game has come to an end for Nadir Zortea. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone).
90+4' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is adjudged offside.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) wastes a big opportunity. He shoots from the free kick just outside the box, but his poor effort goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
89' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle. Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Frosinone.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) comes onto the pitch for Marco Brescianini.
87' Substitution. Hassane Kamara will be replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matias Soule departs the field of play to be replaced by Fares Ghedjemis (Frosinone).
85' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Abdou Harroui will be replaced by Reinier (Frosinone).
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pol Lirola as he is replaced by Marvin Cuni (Frosinone).
84' Frosinone produce a short pass from the free kick.
81' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
81' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' A cross from Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
79' The resulting set piece from Frosinone is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Frosinone will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
77' Keinan Davis (Udinese) gets a yellow card. The referee Daniele Doveri made the right call.
76' 0 - 1 Keinan Davis (Udinese) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
75' Frosinone have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
73' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
72' Walace (Udinese) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Frosinone have been awarded a free kick.

71' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Michele Cerofolini has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
68' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Udinese will take a free kick.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Frosinone.
66' A yellow card for a tackle by Nehuen Perez (Udinese). Daniele Doveri doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
64' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
63' Martin Payero (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Daniele Doveri stops the game and makes a call. Frosinone will take a free kick near the side line.
62' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) touches the ball with his hand. Udinese have a free kick.
61' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Martin Payero (Udinese) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Free kick. Frosinone will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
60' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

59' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Maduka Okoye is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball goes out for a corner. Frosinone can continue in their attacking effort.
58' Fabio Cannavaro is forced to make a change. Kingsley Ehizibue is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Joao Ferreira (Udinese).
57' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

55' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and rose high to reach a fine corner kick. He fails to direct the ball past the goalkeeper as it flies narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
55' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Frosinone.
54' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Frosinone earn a corner.
53' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Matias Soule (Frosinone) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
53' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
51' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
49' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
48' A pass by Matias Soule (Frosinone) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
48' The ball goes out of play. Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.
48' A first-time shot by Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. Frosinone force their opponents to concede a corner.
47' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul. Frosinone are awarded the free kick.
46' Substitution. Brenner is replaced by Keinan Davis (Udinese).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Martin Payero (Udinese) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the right post. Michele Cerofolini has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.

45+2' Matias Soule (Frosinone) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
45+2' Daniele Doveri blows for a foul after Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Frosinone have a free kick.
45+1' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' The linesman makes the right call and Frosinone will have a corner.
40' Matias Soule (Frosinone) fires the ball from the free kick and it smashes against the crossbar!
39' Martin Payero (Udinese) is penalised for holding. Daniele Doveri signals a set piece. It's a free kick to Frosinone, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
38' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
37' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
36' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
34' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

32' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
31' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
31' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Daniele Doveri who sees an offensive foul. Udinese earn a free kick.
29' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) sends a chip pass into the box, but Maduka Okoye is quickest to intercept the ball.

27' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
27' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Nadir Zortea (Frosinone). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

27' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Frosinone force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
20' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
20' Frosinone failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

19' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Frosinone.
19' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) will deliver the corner kick.

18' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the right side of the goal, but it wasn't dangerous and Maduka Okoye made a comfortable save. Frosinone force a corner. They send men into the box.
16' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

16' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
15' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

13' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.

13' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Doveri no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Udinese.

12' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

10' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
8' Michele Cerofolini (Frosinone) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
7' The game is interrupted now, Michele Cerofolini (Frosinone) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
6' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michele Cerofolini intercepts the ball.
5' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
2' Brenner (Udinese) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
2' Udinese fail to score from a corner as Michele Cerofolini (Frosinone) leaps to collect the ball.

1' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Udinese will take the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
